title: The 20 missing tasks from Jason's scope doc in the Work queue
why: Release #284 (task-seed) published but its migration never ran: the site's runner counts a migration as run when every table it creates already exists, and its one CREATE named the decisions table that #283 had just made, so it was logged "already there" and cleared (DbUpdates::all, state 'run'). Jason's screenshot showed the queue unchanged. This is the same seed with nothing to create, so it runs. Jason, 2026-11-24: "i need all the tasks in the que".
